claims.text: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was -5.4 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -81.8 to +70.9). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
The sentiment timeseries showed that price and discount data were unknown during the review window.
Off-topic negative review mentions accounted for 0.73% of scored negative reviews in the window.
Players with under 2 hours of playtime wrote 0.41% of reviews in the window.
Review volume totaled 1231 reviews during the window.
